title: Release miniUI 0.1.2
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_miniUI.html)
* [x] `usethis::use_news_md()`
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] `usethis::use_github_links()`
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [x] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [ ] `revdepcheck::cloud_check()`
* [x] Update `cran-comments.md`
* [x] `git push`
* [ ] Draft blog post
* [ ] Slack link to draft blog in #open-source-comms

Submit to CRAN:

* [x] `usethis::use_version('minor')`
* [ ] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [ ] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [ ] Accepted :tada:
* [ ] Finish & publish blog post
* [ ] Add link to blog post in pkgdown news menu
* [ ] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [ ] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [ ] `usethis::use_news_md()`
* [ ] Share on social media

title: Shiny Gadgets in RStudio Server?
description:
My default, Shiny Gadgets want to listen on `http://127.0.0.1:6976`, but that doesn't work for RStudio Server, which should listen on whatever is appropriate for that server. 

I've tested a number of gadgets (and add-ins that use gadgets as UIs) and they "sort of" work, but are grayed out and the reactiveness is broken. 

What is the solution to Shiny Gadgets on RStudio Server?

unused space in browser view
description:
I am working on [some addins](https://github.com/homerhanumat/addinplots) that need to run in the browser view.  I notice that there is always significant amount of unused space on the right-hand side, underneath the Done button.  When I run a regular Shiny app locally and open it into the same browser, all the space gets used.

When I altered the addins to use regular shiny ui functions (e.g., fluidPage, etc) there was still unused space (and of course no Done button), so maybe this is has something to do with how `shiny::browserViewer()` interacts with addins.

My browser options:

```
> getOption("browser")
function (url) 
{
    .Call(.rs.routines$rs_browseURL, url)
}
<environment: 0x10645bbc8>
```
